security.title: Security that shows its work
security.body: Protection is layered from the database up, and every privileged action is logged.

rls.body: Row-level security means your records can only be read by you and authorised staff.

assets.title: Supported assets
assets.body: Positions are denominated in US dollars. These are the assets the platform tracks and accepts for deposits.

guaranteed.a: No. Crypto assets are volatile and you can lose some or all of the money you invest. Plans show a return target only when one has been defined and published, and a target is not a promise.

demo.q: Is real money moved on the platform today?
demo.a: Not yet. Until a licensed payment provider is connected, every deposit, withdrawal and position is clearly labelled as simulated and no real funds move.

deposit.q: When does my deposit show in my balance?
deposit.a: After a finance reviewer confirms the funds have arrived. Submitting a request or uploading a receipt does not change your balance on its own.

withdraw.a: Request a withdrawal from your available balance. The amount is held while a reviewer checks it, and it's marked completed only once the payout is confirmed.

early.q: Can I close a position before the term ends?
early.a: Positions can be cancelled within 24 hours of opening. After that, they run until maturity.

security.a: Verified email, strong passwords, optional two-step sign-in, row-level data isolation and a full audit log of privileged actions.

minimum.q: What is the minimum to get started?
minimum.a: Each plan sets its own minimum and maximum, shown on the plan cards above. Deposits also have a platform minimum, which you'll see on the deposit form.

kyc.q: Will I need to verify my identity?
kyc.a: Identity checks will be introduced with a licensed verification provider. We'll let you know in your dashboard before anything is required, and nothing is needed today.

reinvest.q: Can I reinvest when a plan ends?
reinvest.a: Yes. When a position reaches the end of its term, the principal returns to your available balance, and you can open a new position from it whenever you like.

referral.a: Every account has a referral code in Settings, and new accounts can enter one when they sign up. Referral rewards aren't offered at the moment.
